record: L-038 capital-structure contract — owner decisions and their implementation
owner: Designated register owner for the R-4.1/IID-2 capital-structure aggregation contract (Ramki)
authority: Explicitly exercised. The owner selected both options from the prepared decision docket (IIPS-V3-IID-L038-DECISION-DOCKET-2026-11-08, v1.1) and authorized their implementation. This is an owner decision, not a recommendation, and not an investigation result.

decisions.selected: Option A — retain the existing strict same-instant invariant
decisions.rule: All four debt components (long-term borrowings, short-term borrowings, current maturities, lease liabilities) must resolve to the same reporting instant before gross debt is published.
decisions.implementation: VERIFIED UNCHANGED — grossDebtOf() already enforced this rule and was not edited in respect of it. The decision confirms existing behaviour rather than altering it.

decisions.selected: Option B — enforce same-instant alignment across the cash side and against the debt side
decisions.rule: Cash and current investments must resolve to the same reporting instant before cashAndInvestments is published; the debt-side and cash-side aggregates must resolve to the same instant before netDebt is published. A mismatch withholds the affected aggregate as NOT_COMPUTABLE / PERIOD_MISMATCH.
preserved: individually valid components and their provenance and period
blocking inputs and their reasons, returned unchanged
no zero substitution, no alternative reporting date, no arithmetic residual
decisions.implementation: IMPLEMENTED — capitalStructure.ts: sum() replaced by sumAtOneInstant(), subtract() replaced by subtractAtOneInstant(), with a commonPeriod() helper; the cash and investments call site now passes both components' periods.

notAuthorized: bridge-wide period equality for minority interest, preference capital or associates/JV (remains a separate unresolved policy question)
IX penalty or confidence policy changes
valuation methodology or formula changes beyond preventing an invalid aggregate
changes to issuer evidence, source documents or historical datasets
resolving L-039 or changing its status
changes to the IPO Screening Engine or IPD repositories

verification.targetedTests: 92 tests across five files, all passing (l038CashSideAlignment 11 new, l038MaricoDebtCompleteness 26, l039CashSideEvidence 18, assessment-capital 8, nil-by-disclosure 29)
verification.existingOutputsUnchanged: ixAuthorizedPolicy.test.ts regenerates the committed IX package exactly (structural digests V1 and V2 unchanged), proving no already-published payload structure moved
